setup: /* Opens the package's launch page with no LMS, so nothing is recorded. __sample() sets an invented course title and language list in the framed selector, as a course builder does in conf/conf.js. __mirror() adds empty, invisible boxes over parts of the framed page so that marks can be measured; they draw nothing. */window.__sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));window.__w=()=>document.getElementById('sco-frame').contentWindow;window.__ready=async()=>{for(let i=0;i<80;i++){const w=__w();if(w&&w.langSel&&w.document.querySelector('.list-item'))return w;await __sleep(100);}throw new Error('language screen not ready');};window.__mirror=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.__m').forEach(e=>e.remove());const w=__w(),d=w.document,fr=document.getElementById('sco-frame').getBoundingClientRect();const add=(id,el)=>{if(!el)return;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const m=document.createElement('div');m.className='__m';m.id=id;Object.assign(m.style,{position:'fixed',left:(fr.left+r.left)+'px',top:(fr.top+r.top)+'px',width:r.width+'px',height:r.height+'px',pointerEvents:'none',opacity:'0'});document.body.appendChild(m);};add('m-header',d.querySelector('.header'));add('m-ui',d.getElementById('ui'));add('m-list',d.getElementById('lang-list'));add('m-title',d.querySelector('h1'));add('m-selected',d.querySelector('.selected'));add('m-launch',d.getElementById('launch-course'));d.querySelectorAll('.list-item').forEach(li=>add('m-lang-'+li.dataset.language,li));};window.__sample=async()=>{const w=await __ready();w.CONF.COURSE_TITLE='Workplace Safety Essentials';w.CONF.SCOS=[{"lang": "English", "label": "English"}, {"lang": "Irish", "label": "Gaeilge (Irish)"}, {"lang": "French", "label": "Français (French)"}, {"lang": "German", "label": "Deutsch (German)"}, {"lang": "Spanish", "label": "Español (Spanish)"}, {"lang": "Italian", "label": "Italiano (Italian)"}, {"lang": "Portuguese", "label": "Português (Portuguese)"}, {"lang": "Dutch", "label": "Nederlands (Dutch)"}, {"lang": "Polish", "label": "Polski (Polish)"}, {"lang": "Romanian", "label": "Română (Romanian)"}, {"lang": "Ukrainian", "label": "Українська (Ukrainian)"}, {"lang": "Chinese", "label": "简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)"}];w.$('#lang-list').empty();w.langSel.renderList();w.langSel.restoreSelection();w.langSel.updatePhrases();await __sleep(500);__mirror();};window.__pick=async lang=>{const w=await __ready();w.$('[data-language='+lang+']').click();await __sleep(500);__mirror();};

guides.title: Choose the language of a course

steps.text: If your language is not selected, select it in the list of languages.
Make sure that the message shows your language.
Select **Launch Course**. The course opens in your language.
